Live: floats 0 .. 0x3E8B5CFD (0.27), mostly tiny (0.0001-0.007). Read as const by ls::ClusterPhysicsLoaderSystem (ApplyLoadResultToEntity, ProcessEntitiesToUnload).

summary: Client scene streaming: per-cluster physics visibility/priority score; ClusterPhysicsLoaderSystem loads/unloads the cluster's physics content from it. On every cluster entity in idle levels.
